rows.name: Bitbucket support
rows.explanation: Runs your tasks on Bitbucket Cloud and opens the pull request there, with the same reviews as on GitHub.

rows.name: Model routing
rows.explanation: Sends each stage of a run to the model you choose, so a review can run on a different one from the code.

rows.name: Team roles
rows.explanation: Gives each person in your organisation their own access to runs and budgets.

rows.name: Audit log
rows.explanation: Keeps a record of every run and every change to your settings, which you can read back.

rows.name: Single sign-on
rows.explanation: Lets your people sign in through your own identity provider.
